The execution was successful (reward 1.0) using the provided multi-step plan for HWPX (ZIP/XML) manipulation. 

Key technical insight for HWPX/HWP automation: Success depends on removing layout-cache elements (e.g., `<hp:lineSegArray>`) after modifying text within a paragraph. These elements contain pre-calculated glyph positions that cause rendering errors (overlapping text or invisible updates) if the new text length differs from the template. Future tasks involving HWPX should consistently include this 'cache-clearing' step in the XML manipulation logic.
